title: I made my opening range + volume profile indicator fully open source
author: person-person12
selftext:
I put this on TradingView a few months ago and its sitting at 22,435 views and 1.5k boosts. Its **fully open source**, so the Pine is right there on the listing and anyone can read it, copy it or pull it apart.

https://www.tradingview.com/script/ylTLH1Gh-Opening-Range-Session-Windows-Volume-Profile/

What it draws:

* opening range high, low and the range box
* configurable session windows
* current session volume profile and the previous session one
* POC, HVN and LVN levels, labelled LIVE or PRIOR so developing structure doesnt get mixed up with levels carried over from yesterday
* a HUD for session state, trend, range size and the active nodes
* buy and sell volume impulse labels that only print when participation is well above normal, otherwise the chart turns into a wall of text

The reason it exists is that the opening range on its own tells you very little. A break into a high volume shelf and a break through a thin pocket look identical if all youre looking at is the level, so I wanted the volume location sitting next to it on the same chart instead of on a second one.

Its not a system and it doesnt place trades or tell you what to do. Its a framework for reading intraday structure, and what you do with it is on you.

If you want something like it built to your own rules, thats basically why I built Agenticks, you describe the indicator in a prompt and it writes the Pine v6 and gives you a script that compiles.
